route_policy: T1 camera-only development route, frozen from navmesh geometry without predictor output, semantic GT, room labels, or object annotations. Start is a PathFinder random navmesh sample using seed 13, filtered to the neighborhood of existing main-route waypoint 4 and reported clearance >= 0.3 m. Endpoint is 0.4 m along Habitat yaw 90 degrees. Entire path is preflighted at 0.04 m spacing with the serialized navmesh footprint (radius 0.1 m, height 1.5 m) and no-slide checks; measured minimum reported clearance is 0.15 m. Scene collision is still checked during actual Agent actions and any collision stops the run.
